biotools.summary: MitoDelta is a computational pipeline that detects mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) deletions at cell-type resolution from single-cell RNA sequencing data. It combines sensitive alignment and statistical filtering to accurately identify deletion events and quantify deletion burden across cellular populations.
biotools.name: MitoDelta
